frozen_implementation_checklist.requirement: Freeze command/script SHA, exact admitted evidence roots, UTC start/end, monotonic wall, actual exit and complete raw stdout/stderr. One 180-second command window; source restore/transfer time separate. Candidate preparation has not started the diagnostic window.

Use stdlib-only helper, preferably Python -I -S. Do not import NumPy, SciPy, threadpoolctl or project modules; do not execute source launchers/wrappers or recorded interpreters to interrogate them. Hash existing executable/library bytes as files; no loading, rebuild, install, environment edit or dispatch forcing.

Read named saved runtime/completion/exit/wrapper/log records within the diagnostic window. Expand original E/F run/cache/source/executable/library paths only from actual path fields in those records; retain origin file/key. No broad /root, /tmp, /usr or host scan; directory inventory stays inside explicitly identified relevant roots.

Separate historical recorded provenance from current observation. Read relevant /proc CPU/process metadata and only named nonsecret environment keys: OMP_NUM_THREADS, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS, MKL_NUM_THREADS, NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS, OPENBLAS_CORETYPE, GOTO_NUM_THREADS, BLIS_NUM_THREADS. Never dump full environment or unrelated process command lines. Current /proc cannot attest original execution.

For recorded executable/shared-library paths record existence, file type, bytes, SHA, provenance and symlink/resolved-target scope. Read related package/build metadata as text only after exact path identification. Active BLAS dispatch unavailable without import remains NOT_OBSERVED_WITHOUT_IMPORT; historical basename/version equality does not prove binary equality.

Inventory only existing persisted CSC candidates in scoped locations, with file/member names, bytes, SHA, dtype, shape, byte order, storage order and provenance. Safe archive/header inspection is allowed; no unpickling or sparse reassembly. A matching unbound cache remains CANDIDATE_ONLY.

Only if BOTH original reference and failed-current data/indices/indptr payloads are individually provenance-bound and match recorded raw little-endian C-order identities: compare structure first, then at most one saved-data comparison <=90 seconds wholly inside the 180-second window, with blocks <=262144 entries. No silent conversion, reconstruction, solve or fallback.

Conditional comparison retains exact unequal-entry count, first differing CSC index and row/column, max absolute difference, explicitly zero-aware relative error, finite same-sign ULP distances and signed differences. Report signed-zero/sign/nonfinite categories separately. No clipping, tolerance admission, numerical-equivalence or physics inference. If data exist but provenance/format/implementation is insufficient, return that typed blocker rather than claiming missing values.

Missing either original value payload returns MISSING_PERSISTED_OPERATOR_VALUES and exact queried scope. Distinguish NOT_FOUND_IN_QUERIED_LOCATIONS, permission failure, unsupported format, deadline and partial hash. Do not claim global absence. No diagnostic restart or budget reset after failure/timeout.

Preserve historical F G reserved/completed 1/1 and execute/collect/wrapper exits 1/0/1. New G/resolvent/solve/pulse/expm/F retry/frontier counts remain zero. Old G 1-run/90-second allowance remains unconsumed and inactive; global execution inventory remains incomplete.

Keep F HOLD_OPERATOR_BINDING_UNRESOLVED and G BLOCKED_BY_F_OPERATOR_BINDING_HOLD irrespective of intake completion. Preserve G-R01, original G claim ceiling and inherited gates. Cause, roundoff-only, physical equivalence/non-equivalence and error size without values stay unresolved.

Return frozen implementation/output/code identities and actual execution evidence for a fresh independent final reviewer. Candidate/acceptance designer is not eligible for final independent admission. Restore integrity, metadata success and scientific approval remain separate claims.
